displayName: 夏洛克·福尔摩斯（BBC版） Sherlock Holmes (BBC Sherlock)
description: Unofficial Sherlock Holmes fan-art companion inspired by the fictional detective in BBC Sherlock. Original animation features scarf adjustment, examining a note with a magnifier, brief violin playing, thoughtful fingertip poses, notebook review and a scarf-holding jump. Compact stylization and simplified tailoring are creative adaptations. Independently drawn fan art; no official affiliation or authorization is claimed.
author: Cozy Critters Studio
